summary: The Certification document involves the management and update of student certifications, including functions for handling updates, sorting, paging, data binding, user session checks, and JavaScript setup.
purpose: To manage and update student certification details such as effective dates, expiry dates, certification numbers, and statuses.

workflows.name: Update Certification Data
steps: Handle row commands for saving or updating certifications

business_rules: Hide edit options if student has graduated or is inactive
Fetch certification data based on student ID
validations: Ensure effective date is before expiry date
Check user session before processing updates
conditions: Check if student record is dirty before saving
system_behavior: Enable or disable controls based on user access rights
Provide JavaScript variables for client-side execution
exceptions: Cancellation of operations if session is invalid
